spec.candidate: first unchanged scheduled decision after each run of hikes; intermeeting changes count; no later holds until a renewed hike
spec.signal_kind: numerical-only research extension; communication condition explicitly deferred
spec.availability: ALFRED day-only vintages usable at following calendar-day midnight ET; ingestion-only facts and approved estimates usable at actual UTC ingestion time; never backdated

inflation.note: core disinflation plus both CPI measures below the existing high-inflation threshold

expectations.proxy: Cleveland Fed model-based estimate; not a pure survey; archive availability limits early cycles

spec.productivity: YoY context only, contemporaneously available; wage growth minus productivity growth is descriptive, not unit labor costs
spec.missing: any missing/stale required transformation blocks activation; optional productivity/communications never filled
spec.communication: archive official statements, clock and document lineage for inspection; no reliable validated historical text classifier, no text in signal
spec.evaluation: each usable 10Y-CMT session close while hold_after_hiking; activated position latched until a new hike; cut enters duration regardless
spec.baseline: 100% duration after first scheduled hold; otherwise existing state allocation
spec.completion_filter: 100% bills during hold_after_hiking until numerical signal; 100% duration after activation or an actual cut
spec.costs: 5bp times absolute duration-weight change, including initial entry; no bills-leg fee; no forced final exit
spec.financing: existing 91-day discount-bill investment-yield convention; start-interval rate
spec.return_horizon_timing: entry one session after first close seeing pause; exit one session after first close on/after decision-date plus 1/3/6 calendar months
spec.outcome_censoring: no renewed hike in six months is known only after six calendar months of follow-up; a cut does not terminate follow-up
spec.primary: SYN2Y completion-filter minus baseline net cumulative return, same common path; cycle-paired differences for uncertainty
spec.reserved_note: reserved whole cycles, not pristine out-of-sample: prior exposure to their outcomes

inference.unit: paired full-cycle net-return differences; no overlapping-month p-values

spec.inflation_descriptions: existing headline L1_FIXED high >=3.5 and M1_DYOY_3M rising >0.30/falling <-0.30; unknown separate; never used as retrospective labels
